records.description: The repository does not provide one lineage-wide contract distinguishing raw, normalized, and scaled model inputs.
records.observed_metric_or_result: No single authoritative lineage-wide matrix-scale declaration was found.
records.scientific_consequence: A hidden scale change could invalidate transfer, masking, and perturbation interpretation.
records.v4_prevention: Freeze matrix semantics, transform parameters, and matrix hashes before v4A training.

records.description: The source AnnData layer used by every historical model is not established by one current repository artifact.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Lineage-wide source-layer equivalence remains unverified.
records.scientific_consequence: The same H5AD can yield materially different inputs depending on X, raw, or layers selection.
records.v4_prevention: Record source object, source layer, sparsity, dtype, and transform in the v4 dataset manifest.

records.description: Feature order was treated as a reproducibility boundary in the frozen perturbation pipeline.
records.observed_metric_or_result: All Stage77 scenarios record feature_order_hash=4f65c677c8673754756118c6d978a3c04e73a57f7002d42e8550932b94b89662.
records.scientific_consequence: Unnoticed reordering would apply expression and graph effects to the wrong genes.
records.v4_prevention: Require ordered feature files plus hashes at build, checkpoint load, and inference.

records.description: A complete audit of duplicate, alias-colliding, or ambiguous gene symbols is not discoverable for the frozen feature vocabulary.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: duplicate and ambiguous symbols
records.observed_metric_or_result: No lineage-wide uniqueness decision table was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Ambiguous symbols can merge genes or disconnect graph and regulatory inputs.
records.v4_prevention: Create a versioned canonical symbol and stable-ID map with explicit duplicate policy.

records.description: The frozen 2,957-gene feature space omits regulators and candidate targets needed by Stage75 evidence.
records.observed_metric_or_result: CEBPA and RELA are absent; Tier A target coverage is ELF1 23/25, SPI1 14/15, and STAT1 16/18.
records.scientific_consequence: Regulatory simulations were restricted by vocabulary rather than only by evidence strength.
records.v4_prevention: Design the v4 vocabulary before training and report coverage against frozen regulatory candidates.

records.description: External benchmarks required dataset-specific raw-count size-factor log1p handling and did not establish transform equivalence to SEA-AD.
records.observed_metric_or_result: HBCC used raw_count_size_factor_log1p with 0.9682 gene overlap; external pretraining still did not rescue the deficit.
records.scientific_consequence: Uncontrolled transform differences can masquerade as domain or model failure.
records.v4_prevention: Fit and freeze one train-derived transform contract and test scale diagnostics per dataset.

records.description: A single cross-dataset donor and sample identity reconciliation for all historical inputs was not found.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Dataset-specific donor fields exist, but lineage-wide identity equivalence is unresolved.
records.scientific_consequence: Identity collisions or aliases can create leakage or incorrect aggregation.
records.v4_prevention: Freeze canonical donor, sample, and section IDs with source-specific mapping hashes.

records.description: Stage76 showed that preprocessing and archived baselines require explicit reproducibility checks.
records.evidence_section_or_field: preprocessing provenance and deterministic repeated inference
records.observed_metric_or_result: Repeated inference matched exactly and the frozen readiness report retained preprocessing and feature-order provenance.
records.scientific_consequence: Silent preprocessing drift can make checkpoint outputs incomparable while code still runs.
records.v4_prevention: Make preprocessing hashes and archived-reference reproduction mandatory v4 load gates.

records.description: The causal contribution of domain mismatch to the external-pretraining deficit remains unresolved.
records.observed_metric_or_result: External pretraining underperformed, but domain mismatch was not isolated as the cause.
records.scientific_consequence: A failed transfer run cannot identify which domain axis caused failure.
records.v4_prevention: Audit tissue, assay, donor, cell state, and distribution shift before v4 pretraining.

records.description: Filtering an external atlas to microglia/myeloid cells did not rescue transfer.
records.observed_metric_or_result: 10,325 filtered cells; best mean pooled OOF Spearman=0.2945; rescue pass=False.
records.scientific_consequence: Broad-cell pretraining mismatch was not the only cause of the deficit.
records.v4_prevention: Use cell-state-aware sampling and compare matched and broad external pools.

records.description: High overlap was reported, but exact ordered gene-space equivalence and missing-gene effects were not isolated.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: ordered external gene-space equivalence
records.observed_metric_or_result: Stage34A/34B report overlap fraction=0.9682, not complete equivalence.
records.scientific_consequence: Small but important missing regulators can limit transfer and perturbation coverage.
records.v4_prevention: Freeze an ordered union/intersection policy and report biologically important missing genes.

records.description: Normalization mismatch was considered through benchmark transforms but not proven equivalent across sources.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: cross-dataset normalization equivalence test
records.observed_metric_or_result: Raw-count-like sources used size-factor log1p transforms; latent-scale equivalence remains unestablished.
records.scientific_consequence: Scale artifacts can dominate cross-domain alignment.
records.v4_prevention: Fit transforms on training data and run per-source distribution and reconstruction checks.

records.description: Approved external pretraining conditions failed to beat the locked internal no-graph reference.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Best Stage33B=0.2711, Stage33C=0.3049, Stage34A=0.2945, Stage34B=0.2782 versus Stage27C=0.3267.
records.scientific_consequence: More external data did not automatically produce a better SEA-AD representation.
records.v4_prevention: Require parent-baseline comparisons and diagnose transfer dimensions independently.

records.description: Data used in training or development cannot later serve as clean validation.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The registry explicitly forbids clean-validation status after training, architecture, threshold, filtering, or model-selection use.
records.scientific_consequence: Role reuse would contaminate external validation claims.
records.v4_prevention: Maintain immutable dataset-role records and sealed holdout hashes.

records.description: Scalar-only graph nodes risk forgetting which gene generated a message.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The encoder concatenates expression/node annotations with a learnable gene identity embedding.
records.scientific_consequence: Without identity, message passing can reduce distinct genes to neighborhood averages.
records.v4_prevention: Retain explicit gene tokens/identity in v4A and every graph-aware extension.

records.description: Graph diffusion required a residual anti-oversmoothing experiment and still failed the full gate.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Best weak residual graph=0.3264; full Stage31 pass=False; topology-specific utility not established.
records.scientific_consequence: Message passing can erase expression-specific information without adding useful topology.
records.v4_prevention: Use soft adapters, residual paths, shallow propagation, and expression-only parent comparisons.

records.description: The real graph did not beat the locked no-graph internal reference under mandatory controls.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Real graph mean pooled OOF Spearman=0.3205; graph-specific pass=False; identity/no-graph remained best.
records.scientific_consequence: A graph branch cannot be credited for representation value without beating expression-only.
records.v4_prevention: Make v4A the required parent and reject v4B gains that do not beat it under matched training.

records.description: Real topology did not consistently separate from all matched controls across later analyses.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The frozen interpretation reports 10 metric-invariant diagnostics and 38 zero-variance null comparisons.
records.scientific_consequence: Apparent perturbation effects may reflect input arithmetic rather than regulatory topology.
records.v4_prevention: Require no-prior, zero-weight, TF-label, edge-shuffle, and matched-target controls.

records.description: The first guarded positive module-scale graph result was extremely small and internal only.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Stage35C=0.327265 versus Stage27C no-graph=0.326702, delta=0.000563.
records.scientific_consequence: A technically positive gate does not imply meaningful biological utility.
records.v4_prevention: Report effect size and uncertainty and keep technical and biological pass criteria separate.

records.description: A machine-readable mapping that prevents unrelated historical graph priors from being mixed into v4 is not yet frozen.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: graph lineage compatibility contract
records.observed_metric_or_result: STRING, module, residual, perturbation, and Stage75 regulatory graphs have distinct roles.
records.scientific_consequence: Combining incompatible priors can make controls uninterpretable.
records.v4_prevention: Version every graph source, transform, vocabulary, and allowed role before v4B.

records.description: A generic interaction prior did not establish context-specific microglial regulatory utility.
records.observed_metric_or_result: No benchmark ran because no approved local perturbation-derived graph was available.
records.scientific_consequence: Generic topology may not encode state-specific regulator-target behavior.
records.v4_prevention: Treat regulatory priors as soft masks/adapters and demand context-specific controls.

records.description: Generated artifacts required explicit deterministic serialization and byte-hash handling.
records.evidence_section_or_field: latest commit subjects for Stage79 visualization artifacts
records.observed_metric_or_result: Tracked history includes deterministic gzip and visualization byte-hash corrections before the v4 launchpad.
records.scientific_consequence: Byte instability breaks provenance even when scientific content is unchanged.
records.v4_prevention: Use sorted serialization, fixed gzip metadata, and byte-level repeat-run tests.

records.description: The frozen Stage79 explorer did not claim an instrumented browser test when the tool was unavailable.
records.observed_metric_or_result: browser_smoke_execution_status=not_run_tool_unavailable and runtime network request count is not asserted.
records.scientific_consequence: Static generation success does not prove runtime interaction quality.
records.v4_prevention: Keep static and instrumented browser validation separate and record both honestly.

records.description: Historical reports serialized machine-specific Windows paths before portability cleanup.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The report contains a machine-specific Windows absolute source path.
records.scientific_consequence: Machine paths make artifacts nonportable and can expose irrelevant local details.
records.v4_prevention: Serialize repository-relative logical paths and scan every compact output.

records.description: Large self-contained HTML and compressed payloads needed deterministic build and hash verification.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The frozen explorer records an HTML SHA-256 plus hashes for all embedded source artifacts.
records.scientific_consequence: Unstable generated bytes obscure whether a scientific result changed.
records.v4_prevention: Pin bundled dependencies, stable ordering, fixed compression metadata, and source hashes.

records.description: Implementation and artifact provenance required explicit commit and source-hash linkage.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The report records separate implementation/freeze commits and validates all source hashes.
records.scientific_consequence: Outputs can otherwise outlive or mismatch the code that produced them.
records.v4_prevention: Retain separate implementation and freeze commits with source commit and hashes.

records.description: The repository explicitly protects raw data, checkpoints, run folders, logs, and unreviewed generated artifacts from commits.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The v4 checklist lists raw data, large resources, checkpoints, runs, logs, scratch bundles, and unreviewed artifacts as local-only.
records.scientific_consequence: Accidental staging can bloat history or publish restricted data.
records.v4_prevention: Use ignored v4 namespaces, explicit staging paths, and staged-file review before every commit.

records.description: The frozen perturbation scenarios used model-input magnitudes 0.10 and 0.25 without biological dose semantics.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Twelve scenarios used up/down at 0.10 and 0.25 for STAT1, ELF1, and SPI1.
records.scientific_consequence: Model-space magnitudes cannot be interpreted as percent expression, dose, or fold change.
records.v4_prevention: v4E must learn or anchor perturbation magnitude to measured perturbation data.

records.description: No measured dose-response mapping calibrated the Stage77 perturbation inputs.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The stage produced bounded expression deltas only and did not claim biological calibration.
records.scientific_consequence: Scenario size has no direct biological effect-size interpretation.
records.v4_prevention: Require perturbation datasets with dose, time, and direction metadata before v4E claims.

records.description: The perturbation MVP propagated signed TF effects only through the frozen candidate TF-target edge set.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The model used 53 usable signed edges for three Tier A regulators.
records.scientific_consequence: One-hop propagation omits feedback, indirect pathways, and temporal response.
records.v4_prevention: Define explicit controller dynamics and compare one-hop, multi-step, and no-propagation controls.

records.description: Desired TF direction remained unresolved for simulated regulators.
records.observed_metric_or_result: All ten regulator rows mark unresolved_desired_perturbation_direction=True.
records.scientific_consequence: Up or down simulations cannot be framed as rescue directions.
records.v4_prevention: Keep both directions until independent state and perturbation evidence resolves sign.

records.description: Feature-space omissions blocked two regulators and removed target edges.
records.observed_metric_or_result: CEBPA and RELA were blocked; Tier A usable edges were 23, 14, and 16.
records.scientific_consequence: The perturbation set was selected partly by model vocabulary.
records.v4_prevention: Audit regulatory coverage before v4 feature selection and never impute absent targets silently.

records.description: All frozen perturbation scenarios produced very small latent displacements.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Across 0.25 scenarios, mean displacement ranged from 0.000193 to 0.000877; cosine similarity remained approximately 1.
records.scientific_consequence: The v3 controller did not demonstrate meaningful state movement relative to natural geometry.
records.v4_prevention: Predeclare natural-distance-normalized effect gates before interpreting v4E perturbations.

records.description: Many graph-control comparisons were invariant or had zero-variance nulls.
records.observed_metric_or_result: 10 metric-invariant diagnostics and 38 zero-variance null comparisons were retained; no-graph p-values were null by design.
records.scientific_consequence: A visible effect may not depend on the claimed regulatory graph.
records.v4_prevention: Require topology-specific control separation before any regulatory-controller claim.

records.description: Movement toward a latent centroid was explicitly not treated as rescue or benefit.
records.observed_metric_or_result: biological_rescue_claim, causal_validation_pass, and therapeutic_target_claim are false.
records.scientific_consequence: Geometric proximity alone cannot establish biological improvement.
records.v4_prevention: Keep geometric, biological, causal, and therapeutic conclusions as separate gates.

records.description: Variance regularization was once applied after L2 normalization, making variance_gamma=1.0 unreachable in 128 dimensions.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Moving the variance hinge to raw latents reduced the variance penalty from 0.9853 at epoch 1 to 0.4612 at epoch 5.
records.scientific_consequence: The incorrect loss allowed collapse-like behavior despite an apparent anti-collapse term.
records.v4_prevention: Compute anti-collapse telemetry on raw latents and unit-test attainable targets.

records.description: Disease fine-tuning could concentrate biological variation into a narrow latent tube.
records.observed_metric_or_result: The architecture explicitly introduced disease covariance, effective-dimension, and top-singular-ratio telemetry to detect narrow-tube collapse.
records.scientific_consequence: Linear readouts may succeed while local state geometry remains poor.
records.v4_prevention: Gate v4 checkpoints on broad geometry, not downstream ridge performance alone.

records.description: Early disease-stage configurations had low effective dimensionality relative to the selected foundation checkpoint.
records.evidence_section_or_field: Stage C diagnostics and v2.2 Stage A checkpoint selection
records.observed_metric_or_result: A Stage C configuration reported effective dimensions=4.76; selected Stage A epoch 30 reported 65.67.
records.scientific_consequence: Low-dimensional latents can compress distinct microglial programs into one dominant axis.
records.v4_prevention: Track effective dimension on full datasets and set predeclared non-collapse gates.

records.description: Some disease-stage embeddings were dominated by the leading singular direction.
records.evidence_section_or_field: Stage C diagnostics and v2.2 Stage A checkpoint selection
records.observed_metric_or_result: A Stage C configuration reported top singular ratio=0.481 versus 0.056 for selected Stage A epoch 30.
records.scientific_consequence: A dominant axis can create visually compelling but biologically narrow geometry.
records.v4_prevention: Monitor singular spectrum on full train and validation donors before checkpoint selection.

records.description: EMA target encoders are implemented, but a dedicated lineage-wide target-drift stability report was not found.
records.observed_metric_or_result: EMA updates are implemented in src/sea_ad_jepa/graph_jepa.py; stability thresholds remain unspecified.
records.scientific_consequence: An unstable target encoder can make JEPA loss misleading or seed-sensitive.
records.v4_prevention: Log context-target parameter drift, target variance, and EMA schedule in v4.

records.description: Reference drift was controlled but remained an explicit failure mode during calibration.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Stage B drift audit: SEA-AD low-pathology cosine=0.9916 and CELLxGENE cosine=0.9754.
records.scientific_consequence: Uncontrolled adaptation could overwrite the reference manifold.
records.v4_prevention: Retain anchor-drift telemetry where anchors are scientifically justified, without using pathology labels for selection.

records.description: Short-run telemetry did not reliably predict full-dataset geometry.
records.observed_metric_or_result: 20-step effective dimensions=75.51, while full-dataset evaluation was 40.62 with top singular ratio=0.268.
records.scientific_consequence: A checkpoint can appear safe during minibatch telemetry yet fail on the complete evaluation set.
records.v4_prevention: Require full-dataset self-supervised geometry audits before checkpoint acceptance.

records.description: The stability of central representation conclusions across training seeds is not established by one current report.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Several historical ablations explicitly report a single seed; no lineage-wide seed interval was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Single-seed improvements may not reproduce.
records.v4_prevention: Predeclare multiple training seeds and report distributions for every v4 gate.

records.description: The current repository does not provide one audit proving every historical training and evaluation path used donor-level rather than random-cell splits.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: all lineage split implementations
records.observed_metric_or_result: Later evaluations are donor-held-out, but lineage-wide split provenance is incomplete.
records.scientific_consequence: Cell-level leakage can inflate generalization through donor-specific signatures.
records.v4_prevention: Generate immutable donor split manifests and reject cell-level final evaluation splits.

records.description: Dataset-specific audits passed, but complete donor overlap across all v4 candidate datasets is not yet established.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search plus dataset-specific leakage tables
records.observed_metric_or_result: Stage33B and Stage34A report leakage_audit_pass=True; cross-source v4 overlap is not audited.
records.scientific_consequence: The same donor in pretraining and test data would invalidate holdout claims.
records.v4_prevention: Hash normalized donor identities across every source before assigning roles.

records.description: No implemented spatial dataset or section-level split manifest exists yet.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Spatial modeling is future work in docs/architecture.md.
records.scientific_consequence: Cells from one section in train and test would leak local tissue context.
records.v4_prevention: Treat tissue section as the indivisible spatial split unit and freeze section manifests.

records.description: Several public datasets were already used for plausibility or development and cannot be called untouched validation.
records.evidence_section_or_field: Already-used plausibility-only pool and role rules
records.observed_metric_or_result: GSE174367, GSE138852, SEA-AD CELLxGENE, Rexach, and Olah are explicitly not clean holdouts.
records.scientific_consequence: Reusing development data as validation would overstate external generalization.
records.v4_prevention: Keep immutable dataset roles and seal clean holdouts until design freeze.

records.description: Metadata and fine cell-state composition produced large apparent gains that failed proxy-safe locking rules.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Full reconstruction mean OOF Spearman=0.4934 but proxy_leakage_risk_pass=False; latent-only=0.3458 and passed.
records.scientific_consequence: A model can predict disease-associated composition or metadata proxies instead of expression state.
records.v4_prevention: Exclude pathology-linked metadata from foundation training and retain proxy-only controls.

records.description: Pathology-supervised encoder tuning could optimize labels while degrading the self-supervised manifold.
records.evidence_section_or_field: v2.2 Stage B and Fast Stage C Diagnostics
records.observed_metric_or_result: Aggressive SupCon moved the encoder but collapsed global geometry; the frozen Stage B backbone retained decodable pathology signal.
records.scientific_consequence: Selecting foundation checkpoints on pathology can destroy the emergent geometry and leak downstream objectives upstream.
records.v4_prevention: Use only self-supervised geometry and stability metrics for foundation checkpoint selection.

records.description: No frozen audit establishes whether a targeted spatial panel covers the required v4 genes.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: spatial panel feature coverage
records.observed_metric_or_result: Spatial-panel modeling has not been implemented.
records.scientific_consequence: Missing genes can make teacher-student alignment or regulatory interpretation underdetermined.
records.v4_prevention: Audit panel coverage and define missing-token behavior before v4C.

records.description: No validated cross-modality cell matching procedure is present.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: spatial cell matching validation
records.observed_metric_or_result: No implemented matching artifact was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Unsupported matching can transfer identities or states incorrectly.
records.v4_prevention: Use probabilistic matching with held-out checks and retain unmatched cells explicitly.

records.description: Coordinate units and scale are not yet frozen for any spatial source.
records.observed_metric_or_result: No spatial coordinate contract was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Distance thresholds are meaningless without physical units and slide transforms.
records.v4_prevention: Record units, transforms, orientation, and coordinate hashes per section.

records.description: No implemented graph builder currently proves zero cross-section edges.
records.evidence_section_or_field: repository search: section-local spatial edge audit
records.observed_metric_or_result: No spatial graph artifact was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Cross-section edges would create impossible tissue neighborhoods and leakage.
records.v4_prevention: Assert section identity before neighbor search and fail on any cross-section edge.

records.description: Section-level train, validation, and test assignment is not yet defined in an executable manifest.
records.observed_metric_or_result: No spatial split artifact was found.
records.scientific_consequence: Random-cell splitting would leak local morphology and neighborhood structure.
records.v4_prevention: Split by donor first and tissue section within the spatial policy.

records.description: Equivalence between spatial-panel and full-transcriptome expression scales is untested.
records.observed_metric_or_result: No teacher-student scale calibration report was found.
records.scientific_consequence: A modality shift could dominate the spatial latent branch.
records.v4_prevention: Use modality-aware normalization and held-out teacher-student reconstruction diagnostics.

records.description: No evidence yet supports interpreting modeled spatial propagation as causal signaling.
records.observed_metric_or_result: Spatial modeling is planned but not implemented or validated.
records.scientific_consequence: Neighborhood association could be mislabeled as cell-cell communication.
records.v4_prevention: Freeze association-only wording until intervention or orthogonal causal evidence exists.
